t: A free, child-friendly desktop of learning Activities for Linux computers.
steps: Read the Sugar documentation and plan a trial on one computer.
Ask IT to install the sucrose package on Debian or Ubuntu.
Fedora users can install the sugar-desktop group.
Choose Sugar at the login screen.
Try Sugar on a Stick if you cannot change the installed system.
Sugarizer is the browser option for Chromebooks.
Try each Activity and choose three for your class.
The internet is needed only at setup.
